question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts has created the Union territories in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th Constitutional Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 7th Constitutional Amendment Act was enacted in 1956.
 
• This amendment reorganized the states based on linguistic lines and led to the creation of Union territories.
 
• The States Reorganization Act, 1956, was passed to implement the recommendations of the States Reorganization Commission.
 
• This amendment aimed at promoting administrative convenience and linguistic unity in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Territories in India:**

 
 
• Union territories are regions governed directly by the Central Government of India.
 
• As of 2023, there are 8 Union territories in India including Delhi, Chandigarh, and Puducherry.
 
• Union territories have a special administrative status, allowing the central government to maintain greater control over their administration.
 
 
 
• **States Reorganization Commission:**
 
 
• Formed in 1953, headed by Fazal Ali.
 
• Its purpose was to recommend the reorganization of state boundaries based on linguistic and administrative convenience.
 
• The commission's recommendations led to the States Reorganization Act of 1956.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Amendments:**
 
 
• Constitutional amendments in India require a special majority in the Parliament.
 
• Amendments can address various aspects such as state boundaries, fundamental rights, and the structure of government.
